units.source_text: 翌日，我等待着老师把我唤去训斥一番。

en.t: The next day, I waited for the teacher to call me in and scold me.

units.source_text: 这应该成为我解释的一个机会。

en.t: This should have become an opportunity for me to explain myself.

units.source_text: 然而，与上回发生踩踏娼妇的事件一样，从次日起老师就开始了他的无言的放任的拷问。

en.t: However, just as with the earlier incident in which I had stepped on the prostitute, from the following day the teacher began his silent, permissive torture.
